kaynaklar.alinti: currently in a state of transition between two primary regulations: Regulation (EU) No 305/2011 (the 'old' CPR), which has been in place since 2011 ... The CPR-2011 will eventually be repealed in 2039, though individual product families will migrate to the new framework much earlier when new harmonised standards are cited.
